name: Miyama Kaori
source:
She is a resident at Jomiya General Hospital and the only daughter of Soichiro Fukayama, the vice president of the same hospital.

She is a stern, beautiful woman with a dignified demeanor who says what she wants to say clearly.

She has a weakness for Sakaguchi and is unable to disobey his orders. She and Asuka have been friends since their medical school days.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1134]Getchu[/url]]
